## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// Henneberg's surface over Domain, scaled by Scale: the first minimal surface
// found that is also non-orientable
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Henneberg_surface).
type HennebergSurface
    implements IParametricSurface
{
    Scale: Number;
    Domain: Bounds2D;
}

// Catalan's minimal surface over Domain, scaled by Scale: the minimal surface
// that contains a cycloid as a geodesic
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catalan%27s_minimal_surface).
type CatalanSurface
    implements IParametricSurface
{
    Scale: Number;
    Domain: Bounds2D;
}

// The monkey saddle z = Scale * (x^3 - 3 x y^2) over Domain: a saddle with three
// descending directions rather than two. Not minimal — it is the standard
// example of a degenerate critical point, and sits here beside the saddles it is
// compared with (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monkey_saddle).
type MonkeySaddle
    implements IParametricSurface
{
    Scale: Number;
    Domain: Bounds2D;
}

//==
// # Pseudospherical surfaces

// Dini's surface: a pseudosphere sheared into a helicoid, keeping constant
// negative Gaussian curvature while it twists. Radius scales the tractrix
// profile, Twist is the axial rise per turn, TurnCount how far the sweep goes,
// and Inclinations the profile interval. Precondition: Inclinations stays
// strictly inside (0, half a turn) (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dini%27s_surface).
type DiniSurface
    implements IParametricSurface
{
    Radius: Number;
    Twist: Number;
    TurnCount: Number;
    Inclinations: AngleInterval;
}

// Kuen's surface, scaled by Scale: a surface of constant negative curvature
// obtained from the pseudosphere by a Backlund transform. ParameterRange sweeps
// the first parameter and Inclinations the second. Precondition: Inclinations
// stays strictly inside (0, half a turn)
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kuen_surface).
type KuenSurface
    implements IParametricSurface
{
    Scale: Number;
    ParameterRange: NumberInterval;
    Inclinations: AngleInterval;
}

// The breather surface over Domain: the pseudospherical surface built from a
// breather solution of the sine-Gordon equation. Precondition: Wavenumber, the
// breather parameter, lies strictly between 0 and 1
// (https://mathworld.wolfram.com/BreatherSurface.html).
type BreatherSurface
    implements IParametricSurface
{
    Wavenumber: Number;
    Domain: Bounds2D;
}
```
